package.name: san_test
package.description:
SkyHunter v1.5.3 — DCN-2026-022 Gate-1 regression test automation (Tier 3 per ADR-008 — test/tool, C++ for performance + CI integration).
Hosts the integrated regression suite that exercises multiple modules together, simulating Gate-1 (2026-06-05) acceptance conditions. Complements the per-package gtests by validating cross-module behavior (Deputy boot, RTK + Nav2 + RTH chain, mission BT loop closure, etc.).
Scope vs san_l5_regression san_l5_regression: Hub-Deputy / 4-tier Leader / Limp Mode scenarios (S18-1~6 from SAN-TST-INT-001 v1.5 §11) — DCN-2026-001 D-006. san_test (this): Gate-1 acceptance scenarios L5-26~33 — DCN-2026-022. Coexists with san_l5_regression; different scenario sets, different DCNs.
Components: * gate1_regression_runner standalone executable with --gtest_output=xml: for JUnit XML; filters tests to L5_* prefix. * test/test_l5_scenarios 8-case gtest (L5_26~33). Run via colcon test or via the runner. * launch/gate1_regression sim-time launch orchestrating the deps (deputy + rth) + TimerAction to invoke the runner after 30s stabilization.
Note on D-118 CI workflow The DCN-022 spec listed a .github/workflows/gate1-regression.yml. That conflicts with commit 14dd940 (chore(ci): remove all GitHub Actions workflows) — the recent PM decision to remove CI workflows from this repo. CI integration is DEFERRED in this DCN per the C1 countermeasure agreed in the audit session (2026-05-23). The runner is fully usable locally and from any external CI that doesn't depend on this repo's .github/.
Note on L5_33 (Gate-1 demo E2E) Backend (DCN-2026-016 gate_demo_orchestrator) is not yet implemented. L5_33 is a STUB that GTEST_SKIPs with TODO until DCN-2026-016 lands.
Refs: * DCN-2026-022 — this DCN * [[ADR-008]] — Tier 3 (test/tool, C++ preferred) * commit 14dd940 — CI workflow removal (D-118 conflict source) * DCN-2026-016 — gate_demo_orchestrator (L5_33 prerequisite) * DCN-2026-017 — /rth action (L5_30 prerequisite, landed) * SAN-TST-INT-001 v1.5 §11 — S18 scenarios in san_l5_regression
